clause_text: A student shall be eligible to appear in the final examination only if he or she has secured at least 75% attendance.
No relaxation in the attendance requirement shall be granted under any circumstances.
An applicant shall have completed at least 12 years of education for undergraduate admission.
predicate_logic: Applicant(x) AND YearsOfEducation(x,n) AND n>=12 -> EligibleForAdmission(x)

clause_text: Admission shall remain provisional until duly attested academic documents are submitted.
predicate_logic: Applicant(x) AND NOT AttestedDocumentsSubmitted(x) -> NOT AdmissionConfirmed(x)

clause_text: Admission shall be awarded on merit based on admission test and previous academic performance.
Transfer of credits shall be permissible only if the candidate secured grade C+ or above.
Transfer credits shall not exceed the prescribed university limits.
Tuition fee shall be paid before the due date to confirm registration.
A student who defaults in fee payment shall not be permitted to attend classes.
Attendance shall be recorded only after outstanding dues are cleared.
A student missing 25% of classes shall be required to repeat the course.
A withdrawn course shall receive a W grade and shall not count toward GPA.
A student may withdraw from a course within ten weeks from the start of the semester.
A student receiving grade F must repeat that course.
A maximum of six courses may be repeated for CGPA improvement.
A semester break requires university approval.
Two consecutive semesters of non-registration shall lead to cancellation of admission.
Re-admission shall only be considered if the degree can be completed within the maximum duration.
A student may apply for change of program with approval of the Head of Department.
The Office of Controller of Examinations shall conduct midterm and final examinations.
Merit scholarships shall be awarded based on prescribed CGPA criteria.
Scholarship continuation depends upon fulfillment of prescribed academic conditions.
Admission fee is non-refundable.
Fee refund requests shall be submitted on the prescribed refund form.
Every student shall complete the prescribed internship requirement before graduation.
Students shall submit applications for fee refund through the prescribed procedure.
Degree applications shall be submitted through the Controller of Examinations.
Appeals shall be filed using the prescribed appeal form.
Credit transfer applications shall include the original transcript.
Registration shall be confirmed after payment of prescribed dues.
Applicants having an HEC-approved test may be exempted from the university admission test.
exception_rationale: HEC-approved tests create an exception to the normal university admission-test basis.

clause_text: A first-semester student withdrawing within the prescribed period shall receive tuition fee refund according to the approved schedule.
exception_rationale: First-semester withdrawal within the prescribed period qualifies the general tuition non-refund rule.

clause_text: A student missing the final examination on medical grounds may apply for course withdrawal before declaration of results.
exception_rationale: Medical absence permits a withdrawal outside the ordinary course-withdrawal rule.

clause_text: If a university program is not offered after advertisement, tuition and admission fees shall be refunded.
exception_rationale: Program cancellation permits refund of the normally non-refundable admission fee.

clause_text: Specially-abled students may receive scholarship relaxation under the approved scholarship policy.
exception_rationale: Disability-based relaxation qualifies the ordinary scholarship continuation conditions.

clause_text: Students must earn at least 130 credit hours to graduate.
Students with at least 60% attendance may appear in final examinations.
Graduating students must complete all required credit hours.
Admission fees shall not be refunded.
Tuition fees shall not be refunded after the prescribed withdrawal period.
